summary.template:
witch is dominant: in 95% of top designs (range 60%-100% over 8 runs) against 31% of random designs, and in 7/8 champions. Champions lose 0.21 without it. Effective fix: witch.cost 2->3 + flesh_golem.atk 10->8 (no unit is dominant afterwards; most common unit is witch at 67%).

Rarely used by strong designs: skeleton, necromancer.
summary.llm: Recommended changes: Increase witch cost from 2 to 3 and reduce flesh_golem attack from 10 to 8. This change makes no unit dominant, with witch at 67%. Other tested changes were not effective: witch alone did not address dominance, and increasing flesh_golem cost to 4 created a dominant werewolf. Reducing witch's ability amount or health was also ineffective as witch remained dominant. Underused units include skeleton and necromancer.
